newsitem.title: USA: Box oil equivalents reserves fall in '96.
newsitem.headline: Box oil equivalents reserves fall in '96.

text.p: Box Energy Corp said it had year-end 1996 proved reserves of 9.9 million barrels of oil equivalents, off 14 percent from the end of 1995.

Proved oil reserves increased 12 percent to 3.3 million barrels at the end of 1996, compared with 1995, but natural gas reserves decreased 23 percent to 39.3 billion cubic feet of gas, Box Energy said.
Box Energy said probable reserves were 4.8 million barrels of oil equivalent, reflecting probable drilling locations in Mississippi.
Probable oil reserves increased 252 percent to 2.8 million barrels and probable natural gas reserves increased 34 percent to 11.9 billion cubic feet of gas, Box Energy said.

Pre-tax discounted net revenue from proved reserves increased nine percent to $189.2 million over the year end value in 1995, the company said. Before tax discounted future net revenues from probable reserves increased 153 percent to $61.4 million, the company said.
